item.title: Sharing the Housework
item.summary: Two flatmates studying abroad talk politely about a messy kitchen and agree on a cleaning rota.
item.transcript_text:
Malika: Sophie, have you got a minute? I wanted to talk about the flat.
Sophie: Sure. Is everything OK?
Malika: Mostly, yes. It's just that the kitchen's been really messy lately, and I feel like I'm always the one cleaning it.
Sophie: Oh, sorry. I didn't realise. I've had so many deadlines this month.
Malika: I know, me too. So I was thinking, maybe we could make a rota, you know, a list of who does what each week?
Sophie: That's a good idea. What jobs are we talking about?
Malika: Washing up, taking out the rubbish, cleaning the bathroom and vacuuming.
Sophie: OK. Honestly, I hate cleaning the bathroom. Could I do the washing up every day instead?
Malika: Every day? That's quite a lot.
Sophie: It's fine, really. I cook most evenings anyway, so it makes sense for me to wash up.
Malika: All right, then I'll do the bathroom, and we can take turns with the rubbish and the vacuuming, one week each.
Sophie: Deal. Shall we put the rota on the fridge so we don't forget?
Malika: Perfect. I'll make it tonight.
